function: Radio map (pathloss) reconstruction from sparse noisy samples plus building-outline inference with a pretrained diffusion prior: no link-level MIMO/RIS function of areas 1-7. p. 5
notes: Title and DOI on page 1 match the file. Excluded for function: the learned part (an ImageNet-pretrained unconditional diffusion model used as prior, training-free, p. 1 and p. 8) reconstructs a pathloss radio map from sparse noisy samples and thresholds it into building outlines (p. 5, Problem 1, Eq. 20); results are PSNR, SSIM, RMSE and IoU of the maps (p. 9). It does not detect symbols, estimate or feed back link CSI, design beams or RIS phases, handle OTFS, NTN resource control or over-the-air aggregation; its ISAC claim uses no beams, waveforms or resources (p. 5, 'without bespoke waveforms'). No MIMO or RIS system is modeled and the antenna configuration is not stated (p. 5, p. 8). Alternative reading for the reviewer: if pathloss map reconstruction is accepted as channel prediction (area 2), the exclusion would instead be system, since no MIMO or RIS appears; the DPM dataset of the radio map pathloss construction challenge with ray-traced ground truth (p. 8) and the Kriging, RadioUNet and RME-GAN baselines (p. 10) would then be graded.
